## Summary

Describe the change and its scope.

## Evidence

For event changes, list each affected event ID and its directly relevant official or primary HTTPS source. For code or documentation changes, describe the verification evidence.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `npm run check` and it passed locally.
- [ ] I reviewed the changed behavior or rendered documentation.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when behavior or validation rules changed.

## Source Policy

- [ ] Event additions and corrections use official or primary HTTPS sources, or this pull request does not change event data.
- [ ] Event descriptions are factual and contain no rumor, inferred date, prediction, or investment recommendation, or this pull request does not change event data.
- [ ] `verifiedAt` records when each cited source was checked, or this pull request does not change event data.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request is focused and contains no unrelated changes.
- [ ] User-facing English and Chinese documentation remain substantively equivalent where applicable.
